related.title: Suricata EVE：真封包與逾時事件的證據位置
related.titleEn: Suricata EVE: packet-backed versus timeout evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付序號區間表、缺口位置、內容可觀測率與旁路計數對照，明確分開byte與packet分母。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver sequence intervals, gap locations, content-visibility metrics and independent counts, explicitly separating byte and packet denominators.
related.difference: 按event_type、flow_id、sensor執行身份與pkt_src分組，保留事件到實際封包的可定位性。
related.differenceEn: Group by event type, flow ID, sensor run identity and packet source, recording whether a real packet location exists.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學內容可觀測率=成功重組/(成功重組+已知缺口)；僅在兩者互斥且涵蓋同一內容區間時成立。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成TCP內容區間10000bytes，成功重組9900，已知缺口100；不計重傳與協定標頭。 內容可觀測率9900/10000=99%；不能由此推出99%的事件或封包已被偵測。
流程逾時事件不應被強制填入虛構封包編號；可定位比例只是證據型態分布，不是規則正確率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 48筆合成警示中30筆對應真實封包、18筆由流程逾時產生；只對前30筆提供pcap索引。 可定位到封包的比例30/48=62.5%；其餘18筆須沿flow歷史追查。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching content visibility is reassembled/(reassembled+known gaps), assuming disjoint accounting over the same content interval. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic TCP content interval spans 10000 bytes, with 9900 reassembled and 100 missing, excluding retransmissions and protocol headers. Content visibility is 99%; this does not imply that 99% of packets or security-relevant events were detected.

Timeout events must not receive invented packet numbers; packet-locatable fraction describes evidence types, not detector correctness. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of forty-eight synthetic alerts, thirty are packet-backed and eighteen are flow-timeout events; only the former have pcap indexes. Packet-locatable fraction is 62.5%; investigate the remaining eighteen through flow history.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RFC 3339：跨主機時間不確定區間與可證明先後
related.titleEn: RFC 3339: cross-host uncertainty intervals and provable event order
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付序號區間表、缺口位置、內容可觀測率與旁路計數對照，明確分開byte與packet分母。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver sequence intervals, gap locations, content-visibility metrics and independent counts, explicitly separating byte and packet denominators.
related.difference: 建立同一UTC原點的秒值、來源精度、偏移界限及事件區間；僅在兩區間不重疊時產生確定先後的有向邊。
related.differenceEn: Build seconds relative to one UTC origin, source precision, offset bounds and event intervals. Emit a definite precedence edge only when the corresponding uncertainty intervals do not overlap.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學內容可觀測率=成功重組/(成功重組+已知缺口)；僅在兩者互斥且涵蓋同一內容區間時成立。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成TCP內容區間10000bytes，成功重組9900，已知缺口100；不計重傳與協定標頭。 內容可觀測率9900/10000=99%；不能由此推出99%的事件或封包已被偵測。

RFC 3339規範時間表示；此課的有界時鐘誤差模型是教學假設。字串轉UTC不會消除時鐘偏移，排序結果也不是因果證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 A事件名義100秒、界限±2秒；B名義107秒、界限±3秒。輸入CSV保留raw_time、normalized_time、bound、clock_source與原始列雜湊。 A最晚102、B最早104，安全間隙104−102=2秒；演算法檢查區間而非相減名義時間107−100。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching content visibility is reassembled/(reassembled+known gaps), assuming disjoint accounting over the same content interval. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic TCP content interval spans 10000 bytes, with 9900 reassembled and 100 missing, excluding retransmissions and protocol headers. Content visibility is 99%; this does not imply that 99% of packets or security-relevant events were detected.

RFC 3339 specifies timestamp representation. Bounded clock error is an explicit teaching assumption here; converting a string to UTC removes neither clock offset nor uncertainty, and sorting alone cannot establish causation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Event A has nominal time 100 seconds with a ±2-second bound; B has time 107 with ±3 seconds. Preserve raw_time, normalized_time, bound, clock_source and an original-row hash in CSV. A can occur as late as 102; B can occur as early as 104. The guaranteed separation is 104−102=2 seconds. Compare intervals rather than simply subtracting nominal timestamps.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
